units.source_text: 火苗是从安放电影机的入口处冒出来的，几乎大半个蚕房的房顶和墙壁都烧坍了，而柱子和房梁的骨架仍然冒着烟。

en.t: The flames were coming out from the entrance where the movie projector had been set up, and the roof and walls of more than half the silkworm room had burned and collapsed, while the framework of the pillars and beams was still smoking.

units.source_text: 木板屋顶、木板墙和木板地都荡然无存。

en.t: The wooden roof, wooden walls, and wooden floor had all vanished completely.
Inside, there no longer seemed to be much smoke rising.

units.source_text: 屋顶被喷上大量的水，看样子再燃烧不起来了。

en.t: The roof had been drenched with a great deal of water, and it looked as if it would not catch fire again.

units.source_text: 可是火苗仍在蔓延不止，有时还从意想不到的地方冒出火焰来。

en.t: But the flames still kept spreading, and at times fire burst out from unexpected places.

units.source_text: 三台水泵的水连忙喷射过去，那火苗就扑地喷出火星子，冒起黑烟来。

en.t: When water from the three pumps was hurriedly sprayed at it, the flames burst out with sparks and sent up black smoke.
